### Free internet and cable, but metrics over customer care

Anonym...

Spectrum's broadband subscriber erosion (400k+ lost in 2025, accelerating to 172k in Q2 2026 alone) is structural, not cyclical - fixed wireless and fiber overbuilders are permanently recapturing customers in overlapping geographies, and no promotional price-lock will fully reverse this without a network upgrade to symmetrical/multi-gig speeds across its entire footprint (expected 2027).

Billing opacity and cancellation friction are the single largest drivers of customer sentiment toxicity (Trustpilot 1.5/5, PissedConsumer 1.9/5, BBB 2.38/5 with 12,875 complaints in 3 years), suggesting that even where Spectrum holds a local monopoly, customer lifetime value is being destroyed by churn accelerated by trust failure rather than by price or speed alone.
